import org.openqa.selenium.By;
import org.openqa.selenium.WebDriver;
import org.openqa.selenium.WebElement;
import org.openqa.selenium.chrome.ChromeOptions;
import org.openqa.selenium.remote.RemoteWebDriver;
import org.openqa.selenium.support.ui.ExpectedConditions;
import org.openqa.selenium.support.ui.WebDriverWait;
import java.net.URL;
import java.time.Duration;

public class LoginTest {
    static void incomplete(String step) {
        System.out.println("INCOMPLETE: " + step);
        System.exit(3);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        ChromeOptions options = new ChromeOptions();
        options.addArguments("--headless=new");
        WebDriver driver = new RemoteWebDriver(new URL(System.getenv("SELENIUM_GRID_URL")), options);
        try {
            driver.get(System.getenv("PRACTICE_APP_URL"));
            driver.findElement(By.id("email")).sendKeys("priya@library.test");
            driver.findElement(By.id("password")).sendKeys("Pass@123");
            driver.findElement(By.id("login")).click();
            new WebDriverWait(driver, Duration.ofSeconds(10)).until(ExpectedConditions.titleContains("Home"));
            WebElement user = driver.findElement(By.id("signed-in-user"));
            String shown = user.getText();
            if (shown.contains("Priya")) {
                System.out.println("PASS: signed-in-user shows Priya");
            } else {
                System.out.println("FAIL: signed-in-user shows '" + shown + "', expected Priya");
                System.exit(1);
            }
        } finally {
            driver.quit();
        }
    }
}
